student_learning_goal: I can use many-to-one scale on a bar graph.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use many-to-one scale on a bar graph.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot with a scaled bar graph in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.part_title: Part 1: Read a scaled bar graph.
parts.student_instructions: Look at the bar graph. Scale: 1 unit = 5 children. Find counts for 4 categories.
parts.visual_layout: Pre-built scaled bar graph + 4 question lines.

image_placeholders.description: A pre-built scaled bar graph for Grade 3 worksheet, B&W line art. Title 'Favourite Sport'. Y-axis: 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. X-axis: hockey (6 units), soccer (4), baseball (3), football (2). Below: 4 question lines about counts.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_GRAPH at Part 1: keywords name the visual elements.

parts.student_instructions: Use the frequency table to build a scaled bar graph. Scale: 1 unit = 5 students.

image_placeholders.description: A frequency table + blank bar grid for Grade 3 worksheet. Table: dogs 25, cats 20, fish 10, birds 5. Blank grid with y-axis labels 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_BUILD at Part 2: keywords name the elements.

parts.student_instructions: For 3 different data sets (counts shown), pick a scale.

image_placeholders.description: Three data sets for Grade 3 worksheet. Set 1: counts 5, 10, 15, 20 (scale 5 ideal). Set 2: counts 100, 200, 300, 400 (scale 100). Set 3: counts 2, 4, 6, 8 (scale 2). Each with 'Scale: 1 unit = ___' line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_PICK at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, build the bar graph for one of the Part 3 sets.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Use Part 1 as formative.
